key_insight: TransXplainRRG combines chest X-ray images, patient history, and expert-guided report refinement, achieving higher GREEN clinical-consistency scores than MAIRA-2 in the reported evaluation.
clinical_relevance: The framework aims to make automated chest radiograph reports more clinically relevant and interpretable, but clinical deployment readiness is not established.
method: Encode X-ray images with a Swin Transformer and patient history with a transformer-based text encoder.
Generate reports using a vision-language framework.
Apply expert-guided “inside-out” analysis and abnormal-finding extraction to refine reports.
evidence_signal: Trained and tested on MIMIC-CXR and evaluated on unseen IU X-Ray data, the model achieved GREEN scores of 0.327 and 0.605, respectively; radiologists also preliminarily evaluated 100 generated reports.
watch_item: The preliminary 100-report radiologist evaluation does not establish safety or effectiveness in routine clinical workflows.
paper_title: TransXplainRRG: A Radiologist-Evaluated LVLM for Chest Radiograph Report Generation
